events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Jameis Winston threw for 208 yards and a touchdown, Tampa Bay held Cam Newton in check and came up with a late goal-line stand and the Buccaneers beat the Carolina Panthers 20-14 early Friday to give coach Bruce Arians his first victory with the team.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bucs use goal-line stand to beat Panthers 20-14

headlines.description: Jimmy Garoppolo tied his career high with three touchdown passes Sunday, and the San Francisco 49ers completed a sweet and satisfying week in the Buckeye State with a 41-17 victory over the Cincinnati Bengals that left them unbeaten for the long...
headlines.shortLinkText: Garoppolo throws 3 TDs, 49ers roll over Bengals 41-17

events.name: Los Angeles Chargers at Detroit Lions

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford threw a go-ahead, 31-yard touchdown pass to Kenny Golladay midway through the fourth quarter and Darius Slay made an interception in the end zone with 1:03 left, allowing the Detroit Lions to beat the Los Angeles Chargers 13-10 Sunday...
headlines.shortLinkText: Stafford overcomes mistakes to help Lions top Chargers 13-10

events.name: Minnesota Vikings at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Aaron Rodgers threw two early touchdowns and the Green Bay Packers held on for a 21-16 win over the Minnesota Vikings on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Packers ride Rodgers' hot start to 21-16 win over Vikings

headlines.description: Another quarterback, another victory for the Colts against the Titans.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brissett spoils Titans' opener, rallying Colts to 19-17 win

events.name: New England Patriots at Miami Dolphins

headlines.description: Antonio Brown caught a 20-yard touchdown pass in his debut for the New England Patriots, and they scored twice on interception returns in a two-minute fourth-quarter span Sunday to beat the Miami Dolphins, 43-0.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newcomer Brown scores as Patriots beat Dolphins 43-0

events.name: Buffalo Bills at New York Giants

headlines.description: — When Brian Daboll was hired to be the New York Giants coach, there were hopes his offensive wizardy would rub off on Daniel Jones and make him a much better quarterback.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giants QB Daniel Jones still making mistakes early in camp

headlines.description: Russell Wilson threw for three touchdowns, including a 28-yard rainbow to DK Metcalf midway through the fourth quarter, and the Seattle Seahawks held off the Pittsburgh Steelers 28-26 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wilson, Seahawks edge Steelers 28-26 as Roethlisberger exits

headlines.description: Dak Prescott carved up the Washington Redskins' defense with his arm and his legs, completing 26 of 30 passes for 269 yards and three touchdowns and rushing for 69 yards in a 31-21 Dallas Cowboys victory Sunday to improve to 2-0.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dak double: Cowboys' Prescott beats Redskins with legs, arm

headlines.description: Lamar Jackson kept the Cardinals guessing all afternoon, supplementing an effective passing attack with more than an occasional jaunt out of the pocket.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lamar Jackson helps Ravens run over Cardinals 23-17

headlines.description: Justin Reid stopped Leonard Fournette on a 2-point conversion attempt with 36 seconds left, and the Houston Texans held on to edge the Jacksonville Jaguars 13-12 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans stop Jags' 2-point conversion to get 13-12 win

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Oakland Raiders

headlines.description: Patrick Mahomes bounced back from the first scoreless opening quarter of his career in the regular season by throwing four touchdown passes in a near perfect second period that led the Kansas City Chiefs to a 28-10 victory over the Oakland Raiders on...
headlines.shortLinkText: Mahomes' 4 TDs in 2nd quarter lead Chiefs past Raiders 28-10

headlines.description: Eddy Pineiro kicked a 53-yard field goal as time expired, giving the Chicago Bears a wild 16-14 win over the Broncos and their former defensive coordinator Vic Fangio, whose gutsy 2-point call 31 seconds earlier had given Denver the lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pineiro's 53-yard field goal lifts Bears past Broncos 16-14

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: With Drew Brees watching from the sideline with an injured hand, the Los Angeles Rams didn't need a no-call to beat the New Orleans Saints again.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees injured, Rams beat Saints 27-9 in title game rematch

headlines.description: Julio Jones hauled in a short pass on fourth down and took it 54 yards to the end zone with 2:10 remaining, giving the Atlanta Falcons a wild 24-20 victory over the Philadelphia Eagles on Sunday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jones scores late TD, leads Falcons past Eagles 24-20

events.name: Cleveland Browns at New York Jets

headlines.description: Odell Beckham Jr. had an 89-yard touchdown catch and a spectacular one-handed grab in his return to MetLife Stadium, and Baker Mayfield and the Cleveland Browns did just enough to beat the short-handed and banged-up New York Jets 23-3 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Beckham puts on show in MetLife return, Browns top Jets 23-3
